description.en: Animated React blocks and crafts for Next.js and TanStack Start with Motion.
description.zh: 基于 Motion 与 shadcn 打造的 React 动效区块与组件库，适配 Next.js 与 TanStack Start。

content.en: PaceUI is a comprehensive collection of animated React UI components, crafts, blocks, and templates built with Motion and shadcn. Optimized for Next.js and TanStack Start, it provides copy-paste ready code with full TypeScript support, clean styling, and high-performance interactive animations that bring modern web applications to life.
content.zh: PaceUI 是一套基于 Motion 与 shadcn 深度定制的 React 动效 UI 合集，涵盖交互组件、动效微交互（Crafts）、营销区块与完整模版。针对 Next.js 与 TanStack Start 深度优化，支持 TypeScript 与源码级复制粘贴，兼具高水准设计质感与流畅细腻的动效表现。
